title: termal_followup_session to a Kimi reviewer treats a message starting with "/review-code" as an unknown ACP command
outcome: A follow-up message sent to a Kimi review child is interpreted the same way as the original spawn prompt, or termal_followup_session refuses or documents slash-leading follow-ups before dispatch, so a review round is not silently lost to an 'Unknown ACP command' failure.
acceptance: The difference between spawn-prompt and follow-up handling of a leading '/' for Kimi (ACP) children is identified in code.

Either a follow-up starting with a skill invocation like '/review-code' runs that skill as the spawn does, or termal_followup_session rejects or escapes it before dispatch with a clear error; a regression test covers the chosen behaviour, and the review pair is clean.
